# Xynaptic — Full Catalog
> Complete reference for AI agents. 220 live services. Prices $0.001-$0.50, USDC via x402 (HTTP 402). No API key. Every response Ed25519-signed. Verify at https://xynaptic.io/trust

This is the full detail file referenced by https://xynaptic.io/llms.txt
- Map (short): https://xynaptic.io/llms.txt
- Machine-readable JSON catalog: https://api.xynaptic.io/
- Trust: https://xynaptic.io/trust
- MCP: https://mcp.xynaptic.io/mcp

### Company Registry (FR) (31)

- /v1/car-dealer-check — $0.03 — Xynaptic Car Dealer Check — screen a used-car seller (French dealer or individual) before you buy: official registry identity (company, SIREN), compliance screening (status, VAT, risk keywords), plus press coverage. Buyer-side anti-fraud one-call. Informational, not a compliance decision. GET ?siren=123456789 or ?name=Garage+Auto.
- /v1/card-bin-check — $0.02 — Xynaptic Card BIN Check — the first 6-8 digits of a card number identify the issuer: we return scheme (Visa/Mastercard...), issuer bank, card type (debit/credit/prepaid), country. POST body: { bin: 424242 } or { card_number: <first digits> }. Completing the banking suite end-to-end.
- /v1/card-chargeback-analysis — $0.03 — Xynaptic Card Chargeback Analysis — bring one disputed transaction + its context (delay, cardholder history): we classify the dispute — likely genuine fraud vs likely friendly fraud vs service issue — with signals and a recommendation (accept/contest with evidence). POST body: { dispute: { transaction, reason_code?, days_since_purchase?, cardholder_history? } }. Informational, not a scheme decision.
- /v1/card-transaction-intelligence — $0.02 — Xynaptic Card Transaction Intelligence — bring the card transactions (with merchant + country when available): we detect fraud patterns — impossible geo-velocity, small-amount card testing, amount vs history outliers, CNP patterns. POST body: { transactions: [{date, amount, merchant?, country?, channel?}], cardholder_country?: FR }. Each flag has a severity; informational only.
- /v1/company-brief-live — $0.05 — Xynaptic Company Brief Live — the real-time decisional brief: identity, officers, accounts, risk signals, growth signals, agent priority with recommended actions. The daily read on any French company. Parameter: ?siren=.
- /v1/company-changes — $0.03 — Xynaptic Company Changes — what recently changed in a French company: officers, status, HQ, activity, accounts — detected against the last snapshot (shared with company-monitor). Parameter: ?siren=.

- /v1/company-financial — $0.05 — Xynaptic Company Financial — annual accounts from the registry: revenue, net income, per year available. Parameter: ?siren=.
- /v1/company-international-profile — $0.03 — Xynaptic International Company Profile — full global identity by LEI: legal name, legal address, country, legal jurisdiction, legal form, registration authority + LEI status (ISSUED/LAPSED/RETIRED) with dates. GET ?lei=969500KMUQ2B6CBAF162. GLEIF is the global gold standard for legal entity identification.
- /v1/company-international-search — $0.01 — Xynaptic International Company Search — worldwide company search by name (GLEIF LEI registry, 200+ jurisdictions: EU, US, UK, Asia, Canada, Australia...). Returns legal name, LEI, status, headquarters, jurisdiction for up to 10 matches. GET ?name=DANONE. The LEI registry covers entities active in financial transactions — the global identity layer.
- /v1/company-kyb — $0.1 — Xynaptic Company KYB — the full due-diligence dossier in one call: identity, officers, financials, risk signals, VAT compliance, verification sources, agent verdict with confidence. The premium synthesis of the company funnel. Parameter: ?siren=.
- /v1/company-monitor — $0.05 — Xynaptic Company Monitor — watch a French company over time: first call sets the baseline, next calls detect what changed (officers, status, HQ, activity, establishments, accounts). Parameters: ?siren=.
- /v1/company-network — $0.03 — Xynaptic Company Network — HQ and establishment footprint: locations, activities, open/closed count. Parameter: ?siren=.
- /v1/company-news — $0.02 — Xynaptic Company News — the press radar for due diligence: bring a company name or French SIREN, get its latest news from a live web search (title, URL, snippet, source domain), optionally LLM-summarized. Closes the KYB loop: identity, accounts, network AND press. GET ?name=Danone or ?siren=552032534 (&summarize=true).
- /v1/company-people — $0.02 — Xynaptic Company People — officers and directors from the RNE: names, roles, birth year. Parameter: ?siren=.
- /v1/company-profile — $0.02 — Xynaptic Company Profile — consolidated identity from the French state registry: SIREN, legal form, NAF, headcount, HQ, VAT, creation, status. Parameter: ?siren=.
- /v1/company-relationship — $0.05 — Xynaptic Company Relationship — the link between two French companies: shared officers, same activity, same city, size comparison. Parameters: ?siren=A&siren=B.
- /v1/company-search — $0.02 — Xynaptic Company Search — find French companies by name or SIREN: identity, activity, status. The entry point to the company funnel. Parameter: ?q=name.
- /v1/supplier-compliance — $0.03 — Xynaptic Supplier Compliance — compliance screening of a French supplier before contracting: registry status (active/closed), collective proceedings signals, high-risk keyword and jurisdiction screening on the legal name, VAT number presence. Each signal carries a severity; overall level clear/medium/high. Informational screening, not a compliance decision. GET ?siren=123456789 or ?name=ACME.
- /v1/supplier-risk — $0.05 — Xynaptic Supplier Risk — bring a supplier (SIREN or name): we compile the official registry profile, financial accounts, recent changes and press into a supplier risk assessment. GET ?siren= or ?name=. The due-diligence one-call.
- /v1/supplier-search — $0.02 — Xynaptic Supplier Search — find French suppliers by activity: search the official companies registry (NAF activity codes) for businesses matching an industrial activity, with location and size. GET ?activity=fabrication+metallique (&city=). Official French data.
### Crypto & DeFi (27)
- /v1/crypto-brief — $0.015 — Xynaptic Crypto Brief — daily crypto market digest (BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA prices, 24h moves, major headlines) as structured JSON. Refreshed every morning.
- /v1/crypto-brief-live — $0.01 — Xynaptic Crypto Live — real-time crypto prices (BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA + top coins) fetched at the exact moment of your request. Live data, not a cached digest.
- /v1/crypto-correlation — $0.02 — Xynaptic Crypto Correlation — Pearson correlation matrix of daily returns for 2-5 coins over 90 days: the honest diversification check. GET ?coins=bitcoin,ethereum,solana.
- /v1/crypto-deep-trading-analysis — $0.1 — Xynaptic Deep Trading Analysis — the premium multi-dimensional read: multi-timeframes (1h/4h/1d aligned), volatility regime, onchain signals, news sentiment, composite conviction score bull/bear/neutral with confidence. Parameter: ?pair=BTCUSD.
- /v1/crypto-defi — $0.05 — Xynaptic Crypto DeFi — protocol health in one call: current TVL, 24h change, chain breakdown, category. Parameter: ?protocol=aave. DefiLlama data.
- /v1/crypto-derivatives — $0.05 — Xynaptic Crypto Derivatives — perp market vitals: funding rate (hourly + annualized), open interest in USD, futures basis (mark vs oracle), max leverage. Parameter: ?asset=BTC. Hyperliquid perp data.
- /v1/crypto-fear-greed — $0.02 — Xynaptic Crypto Fear & Greed — the market sentiment thermometer (alternative.me index, 0-100): current value, yesterday, last week, classification (extreme fear..extreme greed) + interpretation hint for agents. GET no params.
- /v1/crypto-gas-fees — $0.02 — Xynaptic Gas Fees — live gas prices across chains (Ethereum, Base) with slow/average/fast tiers in Gwei + estimated transfer cost. GET no params. Plan your on-chain transaction timing.
- /v1/crypto-global — $0.01 — Xynaptic Crypto Global — global crypto market snapshot (CoinMarketCap Pro): total market cap, BTC/ETH dominance, 24h volume, market trend assessment. GET (no params).
- /v1/crypto-historical — $0.02 — Xynaptic Crypto Historical — OHLCV history for backtests: 30, 90 or 365 days, daily candles from CoinGecko. GET ?coin=bitcoin&days=365. Returns timestamped [open, high, low, close] arrays.
- /v1/crypto-market — $0.02 — Xynaptic Crypto Market — real-time market regime analysis: top 100 assets by market cap, gainers/losers, breadth, volatility, sentiment and regime (risk-on/risk-off). USD only, agent-ready.
- /v1/crypto-movers — $0.02 — Xynaptic Crypto Movers — top gainers and losers 24h with volume filter (CoinMarketCap Pro): clean lists of real movers, not low-liquidity scams, with prices and % changes. GET (?limit=5).
- /v1/crypto-news — $0.02 — Xynaptic Crypto News — top crypto headlines (BTC, ETH, regulation, macro) with importance scoring, timestamp and source. Refreshed every 2 hours.
- /v1/crypto-onchain — $0.1 — Xynaptic Crypto Onchain — live Bitcoin network data: recommended fees, mempool congestion, difficulty adjustment and hashrate context. Real-time from mempool.space.
- /v1/crypto-orderflow — $0.05 — Xynaptic Crypto Orderflow — real-time market microstructure: CVD (cumulative volume delta), buy/sell pressure ratio, aggressive market orders, whale trades (>$100k), order book imbalance. Parameter: ?pair=BTCUSD. Kraken live tape + book.
- /v1/crypto-portfolio — $0.05 — Xynaptic Crypto Portfolio — bring your holdings [{coin, weight or amount}]: we fetch live prices and compute per-position value, 90d volatility, concentration (HHI), BTC correlation per asset, and aggregate risk. POST body: { holdings: [{coin: bitcoin, amount?: 0.5, weight?: 30}], currency?: usd }. Informational only.
- /v1/crypto-price — $0.01 — Xynaptic Crypto Price — real-time snapshot of 6 major crypto assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA, LINK, DOT) with 24h changes, breadth and top movers. USD only, agent-ready.
- /v1/crypto-risk — $0.05 — Xynaptic Crypto Risk — drawdowns from ATH, 7d/30d momentum and risk grade for major crypto assets. Refreshed every 2 hours.
- /v1/crypto-screener — $0.02 — Xynaptic Crypto Screener — the market pulse: top gainers and losers 24h, highest volumes, most extreme moves from the top 250. GET ?limit=5. Fresh attention feed for trading agents.
- /v1/crypto-tokenomics — $0.03 — Xynaptic Crypto Tokenomics — supply structure: circulating, total, max supply, FDV, market cap, ATH distance, price. Parameter: ?symbol=btc (CoinGecko id). Vesting/unlocks in v2.
- /v1/crypto-trading-analysis — $0.05 — Xynaptic Crypto Trading Analysis — technical analysis of any Kraken pair: RSI(14), MACD, EMA 20/50/200, recent support/resistance, trend and momentum verdict. Parameters: ?pair=BTCUSD&timeframe=4h|1h|1d. Real-time OHLC.
- /v1/crypto-validate — $0.1 — Xynaptic Token Validate — full pre-purchase security audit of any token: contract checks (open source, proxy), honeypot detection, buy/sell taxes and slippage simulation, liquidity depth, exit liquidity (sell simulation), market conditions, news flags, recommended max trade size, composite risk verdict. Parameters: ?address=0x...&chain=1.
- /v1/crypto-wallet-health — $0.02 — Xynaptic Crypto Wallet Health — score any Bitcoin or EVM address: balance, tx count, first/last activity (age), activity pattern and a composite health verdict (dormant/active/empty/high-risk). GET ?address=...&chain=btc|eth.
- /v1/crypto-whales — $0.02 — Xynaptic Crypto Whales — live large Bitcoin transfers straight from the network: biggest mempool transactions and recent block flows, sorted by value (BTC + USD). Spot accumulation/distribution in real-time. GET ?min_btc=10 (&limit=10).
- /v1/fiat-usdc-rate — $0.02 — Xynaptic Fiat-USDC Rate — best fiat↔USDC conversion rate per payment rail (Base, Polygon, Solana): Coinbase spot, spread, network fees, best-rail verdict. GET ?currency=EUR.
- /v1/wallet-screen — $0.03 — Xynaptic Wallet Screen — pre-transaction risk screening of any Bitcoin or EVM address: on-chain profile (balance, tx count) plus risk signals (empty/drained wallet, contract address, low activity, high exposure) each with a severity, and an overall risk level. Informational screening, not a compliance decision. GET ?address=...&chain=btc|eth.
- /v1/wallet-watch — $12 — Xynaptic Wallet Watch — continuous monitoring of an EVM or Solana wallet: balance and value, inbound/outbound transfers, token approvals granted, and alerts on suspicious patterns (approval to a fresh contract, large outflow, interaction with flagged addresses). Returns the current state plus the recent activity window, with source and freshness for every field. GET ?address=0x...&chain=base|ethereum|polygon|solana. Subscription option: 12 USD/month per watched wallet.
### Finance & SEC (20)
- /v1/security-analysis — $0.1 — Xynaptic Security Analysis — premium devil's-advocate-grade report: we collect fundamentals (EDGAR), technicals and risk internally, then an LLM analyst writes a structured analysis with verdict and confidence, citing exact figures. GET ?ticker=AAPL. No financial advice — informational.
- /v1/security-dividends — $0.02 — Xynaptic Security Dividends — dividend history from SEC XBRL filings (official DPS declared) + current yield computed against the live price, plus payout proxy when net income is available. GET ?ticker=KO. Regulator-grade dividend data.
- /v1/security-earnings — $0.02 — Xynaptic Security Earnings — quarterly results from EDGAR: EPS and net income per quarter (XBRL, durations 60-100 days), the 10-Q/10-K filing dates, and the revenue trend across the last 4 quarters. GET ?ticker=AAPL.

- /v1/security-eu-compare — $0.05 — Xynaptic Security EU Compare — two European stocks side by side: prices, trends, risk. GET ?a=MC.PA&b=SAP.DE
- /v1/security-eu-price — $0.02 — Xynaptic Security EU Price — live European stock price with local currency + EUR conversion: Paris (MC.PA), London (SHEL.L), XETRA (SAP.DE), Amsterdam (ASML.AS), Milan, Madrid... GET ?ticker=MC.PA

- /v1/security-eu-search — $0.01 — Xynaptic Security EU Search — European ticker identity: name, exchange, currency, market state. GET ?query=LVMH
- /v1/security-eu-technical — $0.02 — Xynaptic Security EU Technical — RSI, momentum, moving averages on 60-day European price history. GET ?ticker=MC.PA&days=60
- /v1/security-filings — $0.02 — Xynaptic Security Filings — full-text search across SEC EDGAR filings: find which 10-K/10-Q/8-K mention your terms (supply chain risk, AI, litigation...). GET ?q=supply+chain+risk&forms=10-K&days=365. Returns matches with company, form, date, excerpt link.
- /v1/security-fundamentals — $0.03 — Xynaptic Security Fundamentals — multi-year financial statements from SEC EDGAR XBRL (official regulator data): revenues, net income, EPS, total assets, equity, cash — latest fiscal years with YoY deltas. GET ?ticker=AAPL.
- /v1/security-insider — $0.02 — Xynaptic Security Insider — insider transactions (Form 4) of a US listed company: the 15 most recent filings with officers who filed, dates and accession links. The classic insider-activity signal from official regulator data. GET ?ticker=AAPL.
- /v1/security-portfolio-analysis — $0.05 — Xynaptic Portfolio Analysis — bring your portfolio [{ticker, weight}]: we fetch prices and compute per-holding risk (volatility), concentration (HHI + top weights), sector exposure via EDGAR SIC, and aggregate risk with its caveats. POST body: { holdings: [{ticker, weight}], currency?: USD }. Informational only.
- /v1/security-price — $0.01 — Xynaptic Security Price — spot market data for US stocks: price, previous close, day range, 52-week range, currency, exchange + up to 30d history (OHLCV). GET ?ticker=AAPL&history=30. Refreshed intraday.
- /v1/security-risk — $0.02 — Xynaptic Security Risk — risk profile from price history: annualized volatility, max drawdown, worst day, VaR 95 (parametric), Sharpe proxy, beta vs SPY (when available). GET ?ticker=AAPL&days=180. Output: risk_level (low/medium/high/extreme) + each metric with its window.
- /v1/security-search — $0.02 — Xynaptic Security Search — ticker US (e.g. AAPL) -> company identity from SEC EDGAR: name, CIK, exchanges, SIC sector, plus the 10 most recent filings (forms, dates). GET ?ticker=AAPL. Free official source, no key.
- /v1/security-sim — $1 — Xynaptic Security Sim — an authorised, non-destructive attack simulation against a target YOU own: probes TLS configuration, security headers, exposed admin paths, cookie flags, CORS and rate-limit behaviour, then returns a prioritised list of weaknesses with evidence and remediation. Requires proof of authorisation: publish the line 'allow xynaptic-security-sim' at /.well-known/xynaptic-sim-authorization.txt on the target, or provide an ownership_certificate. POST body: { target, probe? }.
- /v1/security-technical — $0.02 — Xynaptic Security Technical — technical indicators computed on price history: SMA 20/50/200, EMA 12/26, RSI 14, momentum 10d, volatility 20d, trend classification. GET ?ticker=AAPL&days=90 (30-365). Signals: price vs MAs, RSI zones (overbought >70 / oversold <30).
- /v1/security-validate — $0.1 — Xynaptic Security Validate — the market devil's advocate: submit an investment thesis about a US stock, we stress-test it against real EDGAR fundamentals + technicals — strengths, weaknesses, factual contradictions with cited figures, counter-thesis, verdict + confidence. POST body: { thesis, ticker }. Informational only — not financial advice.
- /v1/security-watch — $0.01 — Xynaptic Security Watch — the daycare for stocks: we watch price above/below a threshold or RSI-14 zones, checking hourly for up to 30 days; the encrypted result is delivered via /v1/watch-status. POST body: { ticker, type: stock_price_above|stock_price_below|stock_rsi_below|stock_rsi_above, price?|rsi?, ttl_days?: 30 }. Returns { watch_id, watch_secret }.
### Banking & Payments (15)
- /v1/bank-beneficiary-watch — $0.01 — Xynaptic Bank Beneficiary Watch — the daycare for banking: we watch a French counterparty in the registry and deliver an encrypted alert when it changes (status, officers, filings) — up to 30 days. POST body: { siren, ttl_days?: 30 }. Returns { watch_id, watch_secret } — check via /v1/watch-status.
- /v1/bank-bic-check — $0.02 — Xynaptic BIC/SWIFT Check — structural validation of the business identifier code: 8/11 chars, institution code, country, location, optional branch + SEPA zone membership of the country. POST body: { bic: BNPAFRPP }.
- /v1/bank-cashflow — $0.03 — Xynaptic Bank Cashflow — bring transactions, get the treasury picture: inflows, outflows, net, burn rate, recurring revenue/expenses detected, and a simple 30-day projection. POST body: { transactions: [...], currency?: EUR }. Computed from YOUR data — informational, not accounting advice.
- /v1/bank-counterparty-profile — $0.05 — Xynaptic Bank Counterparty Profile — about to pay a French company? Get its full registry profile before paying: identity, status, officers, latest accounts, establishments + payment-relevant signals. The KYB of banking — cross-references our company domain internally. POST body: { siren: 552032534 }.
- /v1/bank-financial-health — $0.05 — Xynaptic Bank Financial Health — bring the transactions of an account, get the full synthesis: liquidity trend, income and expense concentration, recurring patterns, anomalies (duplicates, unusual amounts), and a health score with its components explained. POST body: { transactions: [...], currency?: EUR }. Informational only.
- /v1/bank-iban-validate — $0.02 — Xynaptic IBAN Validate — full structural validation: mod-97 checksum, country-specific length and format, embedded bank code and account. POST body: { iban: FR7630006000011234567890189 }. Returns valid/invalid with the reason when invalid, plus parsed country, check digits, BBAN parts.
- /v1/bank-payment-risk — $0.03 — Xynaptic Bank Payment Risk — bring one payment instruction (beneficiary, IBAN or country, amount, label, date): we return risk signals — country risk, amount anomalies, label/beneficiary mismatch signals — each with a severity, and an overall risk level. Informational screening, not a sanctions list. POST body: { payment: { beneficiary, iban?, country?, amount, currency, label, date } }. Nothing stored.
- /v1/bank-reconciliation — $0.03 — Xynaptic Bank Reconciliation — bring TWO lists (bank_statement + internal/invoices): we match them (exact, fuzzy amount/date, label similarity), and return matched pairs, bank-only, internal-only, duplicates and suggested adjustments. POST body: { bank: [{date, label, amount}], internal: [{date, label, amount}] }. Nothing stored.
- /v1/bank-sanctions-screen — $0.03 — Xynaptic Bank Sanctions Screen — bring a LIST of beneficiaries (up to 100): we screen each (jurisdiction risk, keyword signals, structure) and return per-entry signals + overall level. Batch version of payment-risk. POST body: { payments: [{beneficiary, country?, amount?}] }. Informational screening, not a compliance decision.
- /v1/bank-spending-goals — $0.02 — Xynaptic Bank Spending Goals — bring transactions + a goal (e.g. save 500/month): we compute the gap, category-level cuts with exact amounts, and a 3-step action plan. POST body: { transactions: [...], goal: { type: save, amount_monthly: 500 }, currency?: EUR }. Informational only.
- /v1/bank-statement-parse — $0.01 — Xynaptic Bank Statement Parse — paste a raw bank statement (text, any bank layout) and get clean structured transactions: date (ISO), label, amount (signed), running balance when present. The extraction entry point of the banking pipeline: parse then categorize/cashflow/health. POST body: { statement: <raw text, max 20000 chars>, currency?: EUR }. Nothing stored.
- /v1/bank-transaction-categorize — $0.02 — Xynaptic Bank Transaction Categorize — categorize raw bank transactions (CSV or objects) into standard categories with merchant and income/expense detection. POST { transactions: [{date, label, amount}] } or { csv }.
- /v1/factoring-debtor-risk — $0.05 — Xynaptic Factoring Debtor Risk — pre-advance credit assessment of an invoice debtor (French company): registry status, financial strength, payment-risk verdict (advance/caution/refuse) and recommended max exposure. Informational, not financial advice. GET ?siren=... or ?name=...
- /v1/factoring-portfolio-risk — $0.1 — Xynaptic Factoring Portfolio Risk — upload a set of invoices, get the portfolio risk profile: sector concentration, top risky debtors, total exposure, DSO hint and diversification verdict. Informational. POST {invoices:[{debtor_siren, amount, days}]} or GET ?sirens=...
- /v1/payment-routing-advice — $0.02 — Xynaptic Payment Routing Advice — one payment instruction, compared across rails: SEPA transfer, card, SWIFT wire, instant SEPA — cost, delay, traceability, reach. Returns the recommended rail with the tradeoffs. POST body: { payment: { amount, currency, beneficiary_country, urgent?: true, recurring?: false } }. Informational.
### AI & LLM (14)
- /v1/ai-agent — $0.05 — Xynaptic AI Agent — one payment, full task: orchestrates Xynaptic data services as tools (company registry, financials, officers, KYB) + LLM reasoning, returns a structured report. POST body: {task: ..., siren: 552032534 (optional)}. The premium AI layer.
- /v1/ai-bank — $0.08 — Xynaptic AI Bank — the banking/card vertical agent: bring a question + IBAN/BIC/BIN/name, we run the official validation tools (IBAN structure check, BIC lookup, BIN card identification, sanctions screening) and deliver an LLM synthesis. POST { question, iban?, bic?, bin?, counterparty_name? }. Composite, honest.
- /v1/ai-brief-me — $0.05 — Xynaptic Brief-Me — the shopping basket: ONE payment, a composite morning brief. Pick up to 3 companies (SIREN), 5 crypto assets, and 2 news regions; we collect everything internally (registry, market, headlines) and the LLM synthesizes one structured brief. POST body: { sirens?: [552032534...], assets?: [BTC, ETH...], news_regions?: [eu, world, us, tech...] }. Empty picks = general market brief.
- /v1/ai-chat — $0.02 — Xynaptic AI Chat — LLM inference pay-per-call: OpenAI-compatible messages, model auto-routing (glm-5.3-flash / deepseek-v4.1-flash), JSON response with token usage. POST with body: {"model": "auto", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]}.
- /v1/ai-company — $0.1 — Xynaptic AI Company Agent — the vertical deep-dive: full French company dossier (identity, officers, multi-year accounts, establishment footprint, risk signals) + LLM specialist synthesis and verdict. POST body: { siren: 552032534, focus: risk|financial|overview (optional) }. The premium company layer.

### Dev Kit & Audit (9)
- /v1/code-fix — $0.05 — Xynaptic Code Fix — send broken code, get the repaired version: { code } -> { fixed_code, changes: [{ what, why }], behavior_notes }. Multi-language. POST body: { code: <max 12000 chars>, language? }. For review-with-suggestions instead, use code-review.
- /v1/code-refactor — $0.05 — Xynaptic Code Refactor — working code in, clean readable code out, behavior preserved: { code } -> { refactored_code, behavior_preserved: true, changes: [{ what, why }], readability_score }. Recommend running tests after (test-generate). POST body: { code: <max 12000 chars>, language? }.
- /v1/code-review — $0.05 — Xynaptic Code Review — multi-language AI code review: send { language?, code }, get findings [{ type: bug|security|performance|readability, severity, line?, comment, suggestion }], overall score and summary. include_fix: true also returns the fully fixed code. POST body: { code: <max 12000 chars>, language?, include_fix? }. Language auto-detected.
- /v1/error-explain — $0.03 — Xynaptic Error Explain — paste a stacktrace or error, get the root cause and the fix: { error: <stacktrace or error text, max 8000 chars>, context?: <optional surrounding code> } -> { language_detected, error_type, root_cause, explanation, fix: { description, code? }, prevention }. POST body: { error, context? }.
- /v1/mcp-audit — $0.5 — Xynaptic MCP Audit — static security review of an MCP client config before you approve it: paste any mcpServers config (mcp.json, Cursor, VS Code…), we classify every package reference (exact pin = SAFE, @latest/tag = HIGH, range = MEDIUM, local/VCS = REVIEW), detect mutable dependencies that can silently resolve to different code after approval, and return a per-server verdict with fixes. Pure static analysis: never executes discovered servers, never resolves packages. POST body: { config: <object or JSON string> }. Boundaries: reproducibility signal, not a breach claim.
- /v1/repo-security-audit — $0.5 — Xynaptic Repo Security Audit — static security review of a public GitHub repository: scans the most actionable files for committed secrets (AWS/GitHub/Slack/OpenAI keys, private keys, connection strings), command execution, unsafe deserialization, SQL built by concatenation and raw HTML sinks, and returns findings with file, line, severity, CVSS, why and the fix. POST body: { github_url }. Up to 30 reviewable files at 0.50 USD; when the repo has more than 20 reviewable files a free pre-flight quotes the large tier up front at 2.00 USD (up to 80 files + per-file evidence, one payment only). Static pattern scan only - no code executed, no dependency installed.
- /v1/repo-security-audit-large — $2 — Xynaptic Repo Security Audit (large tier) — same route as repo-security-audit (POST /v1/repo-security-audit): the free pre-flight counts the reviewable files before payment and quotes 2.00 USD up front above 20 files (0.50 USD below) — one payment, no second 402. The large tier analyses up to 80 reviewable files (CI/Docker first, then code, manifests, docs), keeps up to 25 findings per file and returns an evidence[] array with bytes and finding count per analysed file, plus a coverage block (reviewable_files, selected, analyzed, not_analyzed).
- /v1/security-review — $0.05 — Xynaptic Security Review — audit code or config for security flaws: { content: <code OR config (nginx/docker-compose/ssh/IAM/k8s/yaml), type?: code|config } -> { findings: [{ type, severity, item, why_it_matters, patch }], hardening_tips, risk_grade }. Multi-format (Checkov/Trivy are single-format, this is not). POST body: { content: <max 12000 chars>, type?, language? }.
- /v1/test-generate — $0.05 — Xynaptic Test Generate — functional test cases for your code: { code, framework? } -> { functional_cases: [{ scenario, description, input_example, expected_behavior, priority }], test_skeletons: [{ test_name, code }], security_cases: [{ attack_scenario, why_it_matters, test_snippet }], coverage_gaps }. Multi-language, skeletons ready to paste. POST body: { code: <max 12000 chars>, language?, framework? }.
